finality_scope: All20 exact final saved file hashes are directly printed in the last precommit saved-peer projection and whole original final QA (hash-exact readback after commit). Actual commit adds exactly these20 paths, native postcommit24 passes, and the original final-QA aggregator then verifies all20 live saved hashes against peer rows after commit. Checkpoint/copy20 and independent clean-Git closure/ROOT terminal pass. No intervening completed command event occurs between the saved-peer projection and commit in the captured four-source interval. The closure checker body is directly observed and bound to its whole known hash; its successful execution verifies clean Git HEAD/parent/branch and Git/live/copied bytes. Whole postcommit closure, archive and terminal bodies/hashes are unclaimed; the surviving checkpoint digest is a new recovery digest. This does not claim directly printed individual postcommit Git-blob hashes or universal absence of unlogged actions. Inert mentions of the forbidden helper occur inside the allowed checker source; that helper body was not recovered or executed. No historical helper executed, timestamp invented or science re-reviewed.
